slides.caption: Rural North Carolina to everything you need, in about the time it takes to grow up here.

slides.title: Cary and Morrisville
slides.text: I grew up in both. I watched Parkside Town Commons go from dirt to a full shopping center, and it sits right where 55 meets 540. The two roads that made everything else possible.

slides.caption: Morrisville down through Cary and Apex to Holly Springs and Fuquay-Varina, meeting US 1 and 540 on the way.

slides.title: Eighteen new miles
slides.text: Complete 540 opened from the NC 55 bypass in Apex to I-40 in Garner. The last stretch to Knightdale closes the loop in 2028. The road always comes first.

slides.title: What to check
bullets: Drive 55 at *7:40am*, not on a Sunday
Ask what is *approved but not built* near the lot

slides.text: Staying in Cary or looking further down 55, both are good calls right now. Tell me which one you are weighing and I will help you find the fit.
